narr: Another day of an anomalously moist airmass produced numerous showers and thunderstorms across Virginia. This resulted in localized rainfall amounts of 2 to 4 inches in a short period of time, which resulted in instances of flooding and flash flooding.
ev: Luray Avenue around Eastham Park was closed due to at least six inches of flowing water over the roadway.
At least 6 inches of water was flowing across East 8th St near the intersection of North Commerce Street. A vehicle was disabled.
Fairfax County EM reports several water rescues in the Tysons/McLean area.
Vehicles stranded due to high water on Old Courthouse Road. At least six inches of moving water across the roadway.
At least six inches of flowing water across US-50 at Prosperity Avenue. The roadway is closed.
Stonewall Jackson Highway was closed around Rocky Hollow Road due to flowing water around six inches in depth.
The Accotink Creek - Strathmeade Springs stream gauge (WBAV2) peaked at 255.94 feet at 840 pm in minor flood stage. The river rose 7 feet in one hour.
